items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Titled h2 sections exist ('1. Personal Details', '2. Job & Contract', '3. Bank & Tax Information', '4. Emergency Contact', '5. Documents') and every field has a visible <label> above it, but the layout is not single-column: each section uses `<div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5">` so fields render two-up at 1440px (e.g. Legal First Name / Legal Last Name side-by-side, confirmed in screenshot). Also implemented as a 6-step wizard (only one step-panel visible at a time) rather than all sections shown together.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Every required input/select is suffixed with `*` after its label (e.g. 'Legal First Name *'), and non-required fields (Preferred Name, Gender, City, etc.) carry no marker. The secondary emergency contact block is explicitly headed 'Secondary Contact (Optional)'.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Every input, regardless of content, uses the same `w-full` class, e.g. `<input required type="date" name="dob" ... class="w-full rounded-lg ...">` and `<input type="text" name="zip" value="78745" class="w-full ...">` and the SSN field `<input ... name="ssn" ... class="w-full ...">` — none are narrowed to content. Input types are correct though (type=email for personalEmail/ecEmail, type=tel for phone/ecPhone, type=date for dob/startDate).

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: No draft-saving control exists anywhere in the markup or script; the only actions are 'Back', 'Continue', and 'Submit Onboarding Form ✓'. A repo-wide search for 'draft' returns no matches.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: The navigation row `<div class="mt-10 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-200 pt-6">` containing Back/Continue/Submit sits in normal document flow with no sticky/fixed positioning class, so it scrolls away on longer steps. There is also no Cancel button at all — only Back, Continue, and Submit.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: validateStep() in the script only runs on the 'Continue' button click and on form submit — no 'blur' event listeners exist anywhere. Invalid fields just get an `.error` class added to their wrapper div (`wrapper.classList.add('error')`); there is no summary list of errors at the top and no `.focus()` call is made on any field, so focus never moves to the first invalid input.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No 'beforeunload' listener or equivalent exists in the script (confirmed via search of the file).

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Section intro states 'Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG (max 10MB each)' and chosen filenames are shown via `statusSpan.textContent = '✅ ' + input.files[0].name`, but there is no remove/clear button anywhere in the doc-row markup. The file input is `<input type="file" class="hidden doc-input">` (display:none), which removes it from the tab order with no tabindex fallback on the wrapping `<label>`, so the control cannot be reached or activated by keyboard.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence:
`

Thank you, .... Your onboarding packet has been sent to HR...

` is populated with the employee's first and last name via `successName.textContent = `${data.get('firstName')} ${data.get('lastName')}``, but `#successPanel` has no `aria-live`, `role="status"`, or `role="alert"` attribute, so toggling it from `hidden` to visible is not announced to screen readers.

notes: greeting-header: h1 'Welcome Aboard!' with subtext. emoji-icon: 🔒 in the bank/tax warning banner, 📎 'Choose file' and ✅ filename status in document rows, ✓ on the submit button and success icon. initials-avatar-non-person: header logo is a rounded-lg blue tile with the single letter 'N' standing for the company 'Northgate Industries', styled like a person-avatar initials badge. card-in-card: the whole wizard sits in one `bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border` card, which itself contains nested bordered cards (each doc-row `border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4`, and each review-step summary block `border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4`). oversized-radius: outer card uses rounded-xl (12px), flagged by the audit as exceeding the ≤8px radius-scale rule.
